name: Friend Zone 5: Escape
source:
So far...
Will Remington ever notice Valerie's romantic pursuits? How close are Roman and Cypher-- close enough to share? Will Axel do ANYTHING for you? And how far is he willing to go to show you how much he's into you? What will come of your club? Will your friends stick around forever, as you wanted? Remember, for the past four years, you never had a single friend until now. What will happen when they learn your secret? And where will Bartholomew end up next? 
And now... 
The treats are out and the tricks are at play. See what goes down on Halloween.

[From [url=https://playfriendzone.itch.io/friendzoneescape]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
到目前为止…
雷明顿会注意到瓦莱丽的浪漫追求吗？Roman和Cypher的关系有多近——足以分享？阿克塞尔会为你做任何事吗？他愿意付出多大的努力来向你展示他有多喜欢你？你的俱乐部会发生什么？你的朋友会如你所愿永远留在你身边吗？请记住，在过去的四年里，直到现在你还没有一个朋友。当他们知道你的秘密时会发生什么？巴塞洛缪接下来会去哪里？
而现在… 
美食已经出来，技巧也上演了。看看万圣节会发生什么。

[来自[url=https://playfriendzone.itch.io/friendzoneescape]Itch.io[/url]]
